subject: CS352
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all specified topics. The selection prioritizes high relevance to the specific student struggles, combined with strong peer validation indicated by high view counts. For topics like 'Associative Classes' and 'Translating Business Rules', where directly-titled videos were scarce, comprehensive tutorials or practical examples demonstrating the concept were chosen. All hard gates were applied, and no videos or channels were repeated.

coverage.note: Several candidates were too long (>3600s) or had views below the 3000 threshold.

Several relevant candidates had views below the 3000 threshold.
